text: Which specimens have a predecessor organism?
queries:
MATCH s[Specimen] >[predecessor] o[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)]
RETURN s

text: Which organisms consume both a specimen and a species?
queries:
MATCH o[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[consumes] s[Specimen]
MATCH o >[consumes] sp[SUB_CLASS_OF(Species)]
RETURN o

MATCH sp[SUB_CLASS_OF(Species)] >[consumed_by] o[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[consumes] s[Specimen]
RETURN o

MATCH s[Specimen] >[consumed_by] o[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[consumes] sp[SUB_CLASS_OF(Species)]
RETURN o

text: Which ecosystems are dominated by keystone species that consume specimens?
queries:
MATCH s[Specimen] >[consumed_by] k[KeystoneSpecies] >[dominates] e[Ecosystem]
RETURN e

text: Which individuals inhabit the biome where their ecosystem is located?
queries:
MATCH i[Individual] >[belongs_to] e[Ecosystem] >[has_biome] b[Biome] >[located_in] r[Region]
MATCH i >[resides_in] b2[Biome] >[located_in] r
RETURN i

text: Which organisms are symbiotic with keystone species?
queries:
MATCH o[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[symbiotic_with] k[KeystoneSpecies]
RETURN o

text: Which individuals belong to ecosystems dominated by one of their symbionts?
queries:
MATCH i[Individual] >[belongs_to] e[Ecosystem] >[dominated_by] k[KeystoneSpecies] >[symbiotic_with] i
RETURN i

MATCH i[Individual] >[belongs_to] e[Ecosystem] >[dominated_by] k[KeystoneSpecies]
MATCH i >[symbiotic_with] k
RETURN i

text: Which organisms consume specimens whose predecessor organism is one of their symbionts?
queries:
MATCH o1[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[consumes] s[Specimen] >[predecessor] o2[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[symbiotic_with] o1
RETURN o1

text: Which individuals have symbionts belonging to the same ecosystem?
queries:
MATCH i1[Individual] >[belongs_to] e[Ecosystem]
MATCH i1 >[symbiotic_with] i2[Individual] >[belongs_to] e
RETURN i1

text: Which keystone species inhabit a different region from their ecosystem's primary biome?
queries:
MATCH k[KeystoneSpecies] >[dominates] e[Ecosystem] >[has_biome] b1[Biome] >[located_in] r1[Region]
MATCH k >[resides_in] b2[Biome] >[located_in] r2[Region]
REQUIRE r1 DIFFERENT_FROM r2 
RETURN k

text: Which keystone species dominate ecosystems whose primary biome is located in the region where one of their symbionts resides?
queries:
MATCH k[KeystoneSpecies] >[dominates] e[Ecosystem] >[has_biome] b1[Biome] >[located_in] r1[Region]
MATCH p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[resides_in] b2[Biome] >[located_in] r2[Region]
MATCH p >[symbiotic_with] k
REQUIRE r1 SAME_AS r2
RETURN k

MATCH k[KeystoneSpecies] >[dominates] e[Ecosystem] >[has_biome] b1[Biome] >[located_in] r1[Region]
MATCH p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[resides_in] b2[Biome] >[located_in] r1
MATCH p >[symbiotic_with] k
RETURN k

MATCH k[KeystoneSpecies] >[dominates] e[Ecosystem] >[has_biome] b1[Biome] >[located_in] r1[Region]
MATCH k >[symbiotic_with] p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[resides_in] b2[Biome] >[located_in] r1
RETURN k

text: Which organisms consume specimens previously consumed by an individual belonging to the same ecosystem?
queries:
MATCH s[Specimen] >[consumed_by] i1[Individual] >[belongs_to] e[Ecosystem]
MATCH i2[Individual] >[belongs_to] e
MATCH s >[predecessor] i2
RETURN i1

text: Which individuals are symbionts of individuals of an allied ecosystem?
queries:
MATCH i1[Individual] >[belongs_to] e1[Ecosystem]
MATCH i1 >[symbiotic_with] i2[Individual] >[belongs_to] e2[Ecosystem]
MATCH e1 >[allied_with] e2
REQUIRE e1 DIFFERENT_FROM e2
RETURN i1, i2

text: Which species is consumed by an organism that has more than 500mg of glucose?
queries:
MATCH sp[SUB_CLASS_OF(Species)] >[consumed_by] o[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[glucose_store] g[GlucoseStore]{amount>500}
RETURN sp

text: Which organism consumes species of different taxonomies?
queries:
MATCH o[SUB_CLASS_OF(Organism)] >[consumes] sp1[SUB_CLASS_OF(Species)]
MATCH o >[consumes] sp2[SUB_CLASS_OF(Species)]
REQUIRE sp1 DISJOINT_CLASS_FROM sp2
RETURN o

Which regions have a biome type that is not the same as their region code 3?
queries:
MATCH r[Region]{biome_type:!EXACT(region_code_3)}
RETURN r
